claims.statement: Tom Allen set up his claim to the American championship again after beating Mike McCoole.
claims.excerpt: Allen again set up bis claim to th e American championship

claims.statement: Tom Allen lost to Jim Mace at New Orleans in a match for the championship of America, with a purse printed as $15,000; Mace won in 14 rounds, lasting 44 minutes (OCR).
claims.excerpt: New Orleans, and Mace won in 14 lasting 44 minutes.

claims.statement: Tom Allen met Mike McCoole in St. Louis and defeated him in seven rounds.

claims.statement: Joe Goss challenged Tom Allen for the American championship in 1876.

claims.statement: Tom Allen lost to Joe Goss on 7 September 1876 when Goss won in the first round on a foul, for a purse printed as $6,000.
claims.excerpt: Goss won in the first round on a foul

fights.excerpt: New Orleans, and Mace won in 14 lasting 44 minutes.

notes: Historical review of championship fights, so several entries are retrospective. Many numbers are garbled in the OCR (Mace bout date, rounds, purse) and are marked low confidence. The hint's 1870 date and $5,000 purse for Mace are not confirmed.
